text: Marta: Pasting prototype link for timeline delta highlighting. TL;DR: when you expand a version we show changes, but the visual delta treatment is low contrast at small sizes and keyboard focus jumps around. https://figma.com/... Evan: Noted. The thin green bar for +traffic is almost invisible at 11px height. Also the focus trap when you open a version details panel steals keyboard focus from the timeline scrubber. Repro: tab to scrubber -> open details with Enter -> Shift+Tab doesn't return to scrubber. Sam: UX idea: add a 2px thicker accent border for delta chips (instead of the filled micro bar) when density = compact. For focus, use focus-visible outline and restore focus to the previously active element on panel close. Kaori: Copy issue: rollback CTA currently reads "Rollback to this version" which is long and duplicates the header. Suggest short copy: "Rollback" + a tooltip that reads "Rollback to v3.2.1 (creates new deployment)". Also add confirmation sentence: "This will create a new rollout with 100% to selected version." Marta: Good call. Also A/B variants are labeled "Variant A / Variant B" in small caps which confuses screen reader users who hear two identical words. We should include the variant id and percent in the label: e.g., "Variant A 1 (25% traffic)" or something clearer. a11y-bot: Accessibility scan: contrast failure on .delta-bar at compact width (contrast ratio 2.3:1). Also reported focus order mismatch for dialog open/close. Recommendations: meet WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for graphical objects), manage focus with inert or aria-hidden on background, and use aria-describedby for the rollback confirmation details. Evan: For the delta visual: alternative is using patterned fill (diagonal hatch) for small widths + increased bar height on hover/focus. Pattern helps non-color-reliant differentiation. Sam: Patterned fill + 3px min height seems good. CSS snippet we could try: ``` .delta-bar { height: 12px; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 75%, transparent 75%, transparent); background-size: 8px 8px; } .delta-bar.compact { height: 8px; background-size: 6px 6px; } ``` Kaori: For SR labels, please include an offscreen span with full context rather than relying on visual shorthand. Example: `Variant B (v3.2.1) 1 25% traffic` Marta: Rollback flow: suggestion to add a small undo toast after rollback (5s) with keyboard-focusable "Undo" so mistakes are recoverable. Also mention in copy that rollback triggers CI hooks. Evan: Timeline scrub tooltip: currently truncates changelog at 30 chars. Can we show the first bullet + a "View full changelog" link in the panel? For keyboard SR announce, the tooltip should call out version + percent + first bullet. e.g., "v3.2.1 1 10% 1 Fixes: restore config parsing" a11y-bot: Reminder: avoid multiple aria-live regions announcing the same state. Use a single polite region for scrub updates. For critical actions (rollback success) use assertive with short text. Sam: I'll prototype the patterned delta + focus restore behavior and push to the branch. Will include focus management code (save activeElement before open, restore on close). Kaori: I'll draft the tooltip and rollback microcopy and put both options in Figma. Short vs expanded tooltip variants for touch and keyboard. Marta: Plan: patch release for visual/focus fixes (high priority), follow-up for rollback toast and copy (next sprint). Tagging eng-frontend and eng-sre for CI hook notes. :white_check_mark:
